name: DG18 existing W-FULL subject and operation preparation

on:
  push:
    branches: [engineering/pro-dg18-w-full-repaired-prepare-20261116, engineering/pro-dg18-w-full-repaired-once-20261116]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/dg18-w-full-minimal-prepare.yml

permissions:

      github.repository == 'theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.event.created == false &&
      github.event.deleted == false &&
      github.event.forced == false &&
      github.event.before == '6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/engineering/pro-dg18-w-full-repaired-prepare-20261116' &&
      github.run_attempt == '1'

    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact preparation source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: packet
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          submodules: false
          lfs: false

      - name: Check out the unchanged qualified runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
        with:
          ref: 6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191
          path: qualified-source
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          submodules: false
          lfs: false

      - name: Select the existing physical Python runtime
        id: python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.10'
          architecture: x64

      - name: Prepare actual subject and stop at the exact operation record
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON: ${{ steps.python.outputs.python-path }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $gitCandidates = @('C:\Program Files\Git\ucrt64\bin\git.exe', 'C:\Program Files\Git\mingw64\bin\git.exe')
          $directGit = $gitCandidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf } | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $directGit) { throw 'No existing qualified direct Git image exists.' }

          $parents = @(& $directGit -C $packet rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $parents.Count -ne 1 -or $parents[0] -cne ($env:GITHUB_SHA + ' 6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191')) { throw 'Preparation must have only the exact repaired runtime as parent.' }

            --bash 'C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe' --git $directGit `
            --out $out --controller $controller `
            --preparation-authorization-reference 'PRO-EXECUTOR-01: current owner continuation received 2026-11-16 directs fresh actual hosted W-FULL preparation at 6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191; preparation only, with a new operation and separate exact-record grant required before protected execute.'

        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: dg18-w-full-preparation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/PREPARATION.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/SUBJECT.tar
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/raw/**
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/operation/**

  execute-received-operation:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.event.created == false &&
      github.event.deleted == false &&
      github.event.forced == false &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/engineering/pro-dg18-w-full-repaired-once-20261116' &&
      github.run_attempt == '1'

    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the reviewed continuation and actual external references
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: packet
          fetch-depth: 3
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          submodules: false
          lfs: false

      - name: Require the sole guarded continuation push and actual external references
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $packet = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'packet'
          $relative = 'handoff/pro-executor-results-20261115/hosted-w-full-continuation/'
          $references = Join-Path $packet $relative
          $names = @('OWNER_GRANT_REFERENCE.txt', 'EXPECTED_PREDECESSOR.txt')
          $predecessorFile = Join-Path $references 'EXPECTED_PREDECESSOR.txt'
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $predecessorFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Exact reviewed predecessor is absent.' }
          $predecessor = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($predecessorFile).Trim()
          if ($predecessor -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw 'Exact reviewed predecessor must be one full commit ID.' }
          $event = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:GITHUB_EVENT_PATH) | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($event.created -ne $false -or $event.deleted -ne $false -or $event.forced -ne $false -or $env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT -cne '1') { throw 'Only the first unforced continuation push is eligible.' }
          if ($event.before -cne $predecessor -or $event.after -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA) { throw 'Push does not continue the exact reviewed predecessor.' }
          $head = @(& git -C $packet rev-parse HEAD)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $head.Count -ne 1 -or $head[0] -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA) { throw 'Packet checkout differs from the push commit.' }
          $parents = @(& git -C $packet rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $parents.Count -ne 1 -or $parents[0] -cne ($env:GITHUB_SHA + ' ' + $predecessor)) { throw 'Continuation must have only the exact reviewed predecessor as parent.' }
          $reviewedParents = @(& git -C $packet rev-list --parents -n 1 $predecessor)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $reviewedParents.Count -ne 1 -or $reviewedParents[0] -cne ($predecessor + ' 801889a5dada43c4c17d08939c330dd358e56e92')) { throw 'Dormant reviewed source must directly continue the fixed preparation source; no later linear push can re-arm this branch.' }
          $changes = @(& git -C $packet diff --no-renames --name-status $predecessor $env:GITHUB_SHA --)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $changes.Count -ne $names.Count) { throw 'Continuation must add exactly the two approved input files.' }
          $expectedChanges = @($names | ForEach-Object { "A`t$relative$_" } | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive)
          $changes = @($changes | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive)
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt $names.Count; $i++) {
            if ($changes[$i] -cne $expectedChanges[$i]) { throw 'Continuation changed source or an unexpected input.' }
          }
          foreach ($name in $names) {
            $relativePath = $relative + $name
            $entry = @(& git -C $packet ls-tree HEAD -- $relativePath)
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $entry.Count -ne 1 -or $entry[0] -cnotmatch ('^100644 blob [0-9a-f]{40}\t' + [regex]::Escape($relativePath) + '$')) { throw "Input must be a new ordinary text file: $name" }
            $path = Join-Path $references $name
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Actual external reference is absent: $name" }
            $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($path).Trim()
            if (-not $text -or $text.Length -gt 8192) { throw "Actual external reference is empty or excessive: $name" }
          }
          Write-Output ('Verified sole continuation push from ' + $predecessor + ' to ' + $env:GITHUB_SHA + '; exactly two input additions; reviewed source unchanged.')

      - name: Check out the unchanged qualified runtime at its original path
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
        with:
          ref: 6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191
          path: qualified-source
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          submodules: false
          lfs: false

      - name: Select the original physical Python runtime
        id: python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.10'
          architecture: x64

      - name: Receive the exact previously unexecuted operation artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          artifact-ids: '14190058719'
          repository: theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md
          run-id: '43785700341'
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-original-43785700341-1
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Restore exact paths, bodies, refs and current source without creating a boundary
        id: restore
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON: ${{ steps.python.outputs.python-path }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $helper = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'packet/handoff/pro-executor-results-20261115/hosted-w-full-continuation/restore.py'
          $source = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'qualified-source'
          $transport = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'dg18-w-full-original-43785700341-1'
          $out = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('dg18-w-full-continuation-' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + '-' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT)
          & $env:DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON -I -X utf8 -B $helper restore --artifact $transport --source $source --out $out
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Execute the separately entitled exact G0003 owner operation once
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON: ${{ steps.python.outputs.python-path }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $env:TEMP = 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp'
          $env:TMP = $env:TEMP
          $source = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'qualified-source'
          $grant = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'packet/handoff/pro-executor-results-20261115/hosted-w-full-continuation/OWNER_GRANT_REFERENCE.txt'
          $entitlement = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($grant).Trim()
          if (-not $entitlement) { throw 'The actual separate owner grant reference is absent.' }
          & $env:DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON -I -X utf8 -B (Join-Path $source 'scripts/run-r0039-windows-resume.py') execute `
            --plan 'D:\a\_temp\dg18-w-full-43785700341-1\operation\OPERATION.json' `
            --plan-sha256 '8f76c756d7288bfb89f6e1b38d328d5db76ded21989e62fe5b34df1d06ded3b3' `
            --entitlement-reference $entitlement
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Retain the actual restored subject after success or failure without replay
        if: always() && steps.python.outcome == 'success'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON: ${{ steps.python.outputs.python-path }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $helper = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'packet/handoff/pro-executor-results-20261115/hosted-w-full-continuation/restore.py'
          $out = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('dg18-w-full-continuation-' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + '-' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT)
          & $env:DG18_PHYSICAL_PYTHON -I -X utf8 -B $helper capture --out $out
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Retain original operation outputs, process accounting and actual task state
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: dg18-w-full-continuation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dg18-w-full-continuation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/**
            ${{ steps.restore.outcome == 'success' && 'D:/a/_temp/dg18-w-full-43785700341-1/operation/**' || '' }}
